title: Runtime Tool Execution Result
description: Content-light result of a tool execution through the runtime adapter. Contains no raw file contents, stdout, stderr, diffs, snippets, or secrets.

invocation_id.description: Unique invocation identifier assigned by the adapter

tool_name.description: Name of the tool that was executed

envelope_schema_valid.description: Whether the invocation envelope passed schema validation

tool_status.description: Status returned by the tool (e.g. passed, failed, refused)

tool_error_kind.description: Structured error kind from the tool

receipt_sha256.description: SHA-256 hash of the canonical JSON tool receipt

error_kind.description: Structured error kind for blocked/refused/failed executions

refusal_reason.description: Human-readable reason for refusal or failure

tool_receipt_kind.description: Kind of tool receipt (e.g. validate, search_replace)

tool_receipt_schema_version.description: Schema version of the tool receipt (e.g. rig.relay.validate_receipt.v1)

receipt_envelope_id.description: ReceiptEnvelope ID when one is built around the tool receipt

audit_event_id.description: AuditEvent ID when one is created for this execution
